name: Greg Murphy
summary: Gregory Francis Murphy (born March 5, 1963) is an American politician and urologist representing North Carolina's 3rd congressional district in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2019. He lost his reelection in November 2026 amid a wave of Democratic victories and after his district was slightly redrawn to try to benefit Republicans in the 1st congressional district. He served as a representative in the North Carolina General Assembly from 2015 to 2019.
